data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 蔬菜摊前的认真挑选
data.description: 约尔穿米色束腰风衣与及膝皮靴，在超市低矮的蔬菜架旁屈膝蹲下。购物篮稳放在脚边，她一手拿起一根胡萝卜，另一手轻扶篮柄，歪头仔细检查表皮，红眸认真得像在完成重要任务。木箱里的土豆和卷心菜层层排开，明亮柔和的顶灯照清她的脸。
data.action: 蹲在蔬菜架旁，一手检查胡萝卜，另一手扶住脚边购物篮的提柄。
data.camera: medium shot, three-quarter view, crouching environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Crouching beside the lowest produce shelf, Yor Forger from SPY x FAMILY studies a carrot with almost ceremonial seriousness. Her free hand steadies the handle of a shopping basket on the floor. A belted beige trench coat folds over her knees above tall leather boots; black hair, gold earrings and intent ruby eyes remain visible. Wooden crates of potatoes and cabbages establish the shop around her. Gentle overhead light reaches her tilted face. One shopper, no readable labels.
